environment.description: Go Gin application running on EC2 instance in VPC subnet-0a1b2c3d with IAM role granting s3:PutObject and s3:ListBucket on arn:aws:s3:::app-user-uploads-prod/*. Instance routes S3 traffic through NAT gateway to public S3 endpoint. No VPC endpoint configured. S3 bucket has no bucket policy restrictions. CloudFront distribution serves the bucket publicly with no OAI restrictions on object keys.

config.subnet: subnet-0a1b2c3d (private, NAT gateway route to S3)
config.iam_role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/app-upload-role with s3:PutObject, s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket on app-user-uploads-prod
config.cloudfront: d1234abcdef.cloudfront.net serving entire bucket with no path restrictions
